description: Checks whether a PV inverter, battery inverter or other power-generating unit (PGU) is on the Synergrid C10/26 list of devices homologated for connection to the Belgian grid. Returns the outcome (found, found_with_limitations, expired, not_found, brand), matching devices with homologation dates, limitations and firmware versions, and homologated alternatives when nothing matches. Where available, each match also carries a separate "datasheet" object with manufacturer datasheet values (DC voltage, MPPT data, links, source URLs, status, last verified date); these are NOT checked by Synergrid and are not part of the approval. Search by brand and model, for example "Huawei SUN2000-10KTL".

locale.description: Language of source titles and links (nl, fr, de, en). Defaults to the server setting.

phases.description: Optional: 1 or 3 phases, improves alternative suggestions.

smaxVa.description: Optional: apparent power in VA, improves alternative suggestions.

name: check_inverter_c10_26
title: Check an inverter against Synergrid C10/26
